parameters.query:
WITH
input AS (SELECT
  $1::text       AS servicio_nombre,
  $2::text       AS sede_buscar,
  CASE WHEN $3 = '__NULL__' THEN NULL ELSE $3::char END AS genero_pref,
  $4::date       AS fecha,
  $5::timestamptz AS slot_inicio_aware
),
servicio AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.duracion_minutos, s.precio_cop, s.modalidad
  FROM zoe.servicios s, input
  WHERE s.nombre = input.servicio_nombre AND s.activo
  LIMIT 1
),
sede AS (
  SELECT sd.id, sd.nombre, sd.ciudad
  FROM zoe.sedes sd, input
  WHERE (sd.nombre ILIKE '%' || input.sede_buscar || '%'
         OR sd.ciudad ILIKE '%' || input.sede_buscar || '%') AND sd.activa
  ORDER BY (sd.nombre = input.sede_buscar) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
candidatos AS (
  SELECT t.id, t.nombre, t.genero, t.horario_base
  FROM zoe.terapeutas t
  JOIN zoe.terapeuta_servicios ts ON ts.terapeuta_id = t.id, input
  WHERE t.activo
    AND t.sede_id = (SELECT id FROM sede)
    AND ts.servicio_id = (SELECT id FROM servicio)
    AND (input.genero_pref IS NULL OR t.genero = input.genero_pref)
),
citas_dia AS (
  SELECT c.terapeuta_id, c.terapeuta_secundario_id, c.slot_inicio, c.slot_fin
  FROM zoe.citas c, input
  WHERE c.estado IN ('reservada', 'en_curso')
    AND c.sede_id = (SELECT id FROM sede)
    AND DATE(c.slot_inicio AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota') = input.fecha
),
bloqueos_dia AS (
  SELECT b.terapeuta_id, b.inicio, b.fin, b.motivo
  FROM zoe.disponibilidad_bloqueos b, input
  WHERE (b.sede_id IS NULL OR b.sede_id = (SELECT id FROM sede))
    AND (b.terapeuta_id IS NULL OR b.terapeuta_id IN (SELECT id FROM candidatos))
    AND b.inicio < input.slot_inicio_aware + INTERVAL '1 day'
    AND b.fin    > input.slot_inicio_aware - INTERVAL '1 day'
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'servicio',     (SELECT row_to_json(s) FROM servicio s),
  'sede',         (SELECT row_to_json(sd) FROM sede sd),
  'candidatos',   COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(c)) FROM candidatos c), '[]'::json),
  'citas_dia',    COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(cd)) FROM citas_dia cd), '[]'::json),
  'bloqueos_dia', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(bd)) FROM bloqueos_dia bd), '[]'::json)
) AS ctx;
